key_facts: === DUPLICATIONS (13 found) ===

=== CONTRADICTIONS (7 found) ===

C1: Supervisor BLIND vs read permission — supervisor.md L17 says You are BLIND. You cannot read files. But frontmatter L9-10 grants read: *: allow. And supervisor.md L29 lists read as a tool. CONTRADICTION: which is correct?

C2: Template count — AGENTS.md L106 says 5 base templates but L159-168 lists 8 templates (Scout, Advisor, Senior Dev, Tester, Critique, Pentester, Docs Writer, Chore). Plus Ops Board Manager = 9. FALSE: there are 8-9, not 5.

C3: Spawn mode — AGENTS.md L172-174 says Supervisor spawns background, subagents spawn foreground. supervisor.md L104 says ALWAYS background. CONTRADICTION: are subagent spawns foreground or background?
C4: Template table columns — AGENTS.md L159-168 uses Can Edit / Can Write. supervisor.md L124-132 uses Can Edit / Can Shell. Different schemas for the same data.
C5: Chore cannot edit but has bash — AGENTS.md L168 says Chore Can Edit: ❌. Chore frontmatter L8-9 has bash: *: allow. Bash can write files via redirection. CONTRADICTION: is bash = edit capability?
C6: Docs Writer cannot edit but has bash — AGENTS.md L167 says Docs Writer Can Edit: ❌. Docs Writer frontmatter L11-12 has bash: *: allow. Same contradiction as Chore.

C7: Pentester has bash but no edit — Pentester frontmatter L7-8 has bash: *: allow but no edit permission listed. AGENTS.md L166 says Can Edit: ✅. CONTRADICTION: frontmatter says no edit, AGENTS.md says yes edit.
=== INCONSISTENCIES (6 found) ===

I1: Handoff JSON schema — AGENTS.md L202-216 shows simplified schema (headers has timestamp + agent_id only). handoff-output skill shows full schema (headers has timestamp, agent_id, session_start, session_end, vector). Templates should follow the skill, not AGENTS.md.

I2: fircac-out-loud loading — AGENTS.md says OBLIGATORY for EVERY agent. But only 3/9 templates load it in default workflow: advisor L39, senior-developer L39, critique L39. Scout, tester, pentester, docs-writer, chore, ops-board-manager do NOT load it.

I3: Anti-Context-Rot detail levels — scout has 3 bullet points. advisor has 3. senior-developer has 3. tester has 3. critique has 3. pentester has 3. docs-writer has 3. chore has 2. ops-board-manager has 0 (just rules). Inconsistent depth.

I4: Role-Specific Rules section — only scout, advisor, senior-developer, tester, critique have a dedicated ## Role-Specific Rules section. pentester, docs-writer, chore, ops-board-manager embed rules inline without the section header.

I5: Handoff write command — AGENTS.md L218 says use nushell: nu -c { ... } | to json | save .... Templates say Load skill(name=handoff-output) for the full schema. Different instructions for the same action.
I6: Terminology mix — AGENTS.md uses microtask (L75, L149, L244). Templates use task, handoff, command, spawn interchangeably. No standard term defined.

data.for_supervisor: SYSTEM AUDIT COMPLETE — 13 duplications, 7 contradictions, 6 inconsistencies found across 11 opencode configuration files.
